name: intent-par-inspector
description: Intent / PAR inspector: push an authorization request to a mock authorization server (RFC 9126), see the intent bound into the request_uri, the consent and the token, and watch tampering, replay and expiry get refused. Mock only, no tenant, no outbound network.

scripts.dev: echo "run: npm run dev -w server  and  npm run dev -w web (UI on http://localhost:4772/)"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
